desc: Sort arrays A, B, C in descending order.
Use a max-heap to generate the largest values of $A_i B_j + B_j C_k + C_k A_i$ by starting from $(0,0,0)$ and exploring neighbors $(i+1,j,k), (i,j+1,k), (i,j,k+1)$.
Maintain a visited set to avoid duplicates.
Extract the top $K$ values from the heap; the $K$-th extracted value is the answer.
Handle the case where multiple indices have the same value correctly (the heap approach naturally handles this).
